description.value: Tentatsu Japanese Restaurant on Hastings Street is the original Tentatsu location, self-described as known for colorful and innovative sushi. The full menu spans sashimi, robata, nigiri, rolls, tempura, noodles, and set combos, making it a substantial stop for hungry riders. Both dine-in and takeout are available, with free delivery on larger orders within 5 km.

No evidence exists in the website or OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities, so those remain null.
